Why sellers choose us

Local roots. A full team. A clear plan.

Meet the team

i.

We know this place

Nadine has lived and worked in Northeast Pennsylvania her whole life. From the fireman's picnics and parades to the family farms, local businesses and the natural gas industry, she understands what makes each corner of this area unique — and how to show buyers why it's worth calling home.

ii.

A team behind your sale

Your home isn't handled by one busy agent. The team works together under Keller Williams Real Estate, so there's always someone answering the phone, preparing a showing or following up with a buyer. Confirm team size & roles

iii.

No surprises

Before your home goes on the market, you'll know the pricing strategy, the marketing plan and what happens at every step through closing. Clear expectations, honest advice and steady communication.

How we market your home

First impressions happen online.

Most buyers see your home on a screen long before they walk through the front door. Our marketing is built to make that first look count.

Professional photography, video, thoughtful pricing and wide online exposure — every piece is planned before launch day. Confirm services offered
